foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose, and nothing here should change a treatment without your own clinician. Criteria, doses and guideline statements are quoted as published. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: MS Companion is an educational synthesis of published literature for study and patient understanding. It does not replace a neurologist or MS nurse. Doses, criteria and guideline statements are reported as published, not as instructions for any individual. Never stop or switch a medicine without your own team.
shell.note: An animated, cited guide for students, people with MS and their families. Educational only, not medical advice. Your place is saved on this device.
